notes:
=== CONCEPT ===
-iL reads target IPs/hostnames from a file, one per line. Enables scanning a pre-built target list from previous enumeration phases (crt.sh resolution, DNS brute force, AXFR results) without manual IP specification.

=== CHAINING ===
crtsh resolution loop → resolved IPs to targets.txt → nmap -iL targets.txt → comprehensive scan of all discovered company hosts.

=== FORMAT ===
File can contain IPs, ranges (10.0.0.1-10), CIDR notation (10.0.0.0/24), or hostnames. Mix formats freely.
